correctness.rationale: For H_m (m≥3), all maximal independent sets have size two; diameter three gives maximum size two for color-1 and color-2 packings, while every higher color appears at most once. Cover count gives chi_rho≥m and the explicit (a,d) color-1, (b,e) color-2 assignment attains m. A greedy color-1 class is maximal independent, forcing Gamma_rho≤m+1; order e,a,b,c,d followed by remaining clique attains m+1. Unlabeled graphs through five vertices were independently enumerated (counts 1,2,4,11,34), with well-covered counts 1,2,3,7,14; all feasible packing and first-fit colorings yielded exactly one five-vertex gap graph isomorphic to H_3. Enumeration establishes only the bounded uniqueness, not all orders.
